title: chat-client: typed ChatWsFrame::RequestError
description: parse_chat_ws_frame (crate-jmap-chat-client/src/ws.rs:85) maps jmap-base-client WsFrame::RequestError (RFC 8887 §4.3.4, typed WsRequestError with requestId) to the catch-all ChatWsFrame::Unknown { type_name: "<unknown>" }, so ChatWsExt callers lose the request-level Problem Details and requestId. Add an additive ChatWsFrame::RequestError(WsRequestError) variant (enum is #[non_exhaustive]) with a test using the RFC 8887 example frame as oracle. Found during JMAP-yt1w.3 doc-drift fix; README now documents the current behaviour.
